compactPrompt:
When compacting context, ALWAYS preserve in summary:
1. Path to SESSION_STATE.md (from project CLAUDE.md)
2. Current plan step (line with → from SESSION_STATE)
3. All changed file names in this session
4. All decisions with reasoning
5. Verbatim user requirements affecting current task
6. task_id of current task
7. Instruction: AFTER COMPACTION first read SESSION_STATE.md and CLAUDE.md section 4, then continue from step marked with →

DO NOT preserve: contents of vault files (can be re-read), intermediate reasoning, code already saved to files.
